     { x: -1, z: 90, color: 'blue', value: 0.1 },\n190\t        { x: 0, z: 110, color: 'blue', value: 0.1 },\n191\t        { x: 1, z: 130, color: 'blue', value: 0.1 },\n192\t        { x: -1, z: 150, /**\n429\t   * Handle game end\n430\t   */\n431\t  async handleGameEnd() {\n432\t    this.isRunning = false;\n433\t\n434\t    if (this.state.status === 'won') {\n435\t      const level =
